definitions.gloss: healthy, robust, sound, in good health
definitions.explanation: Describes being in good physical health and vigor. Often used formally, especially in greetings or to describe elderly people who are still healthy.

examples.japanese: ご{壮健|そうけん}で⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧です
examples.english: I'm glad to see you in good health

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧90⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{壮健|そうけん}だ。
examples.english: My grandfather is still robust at 90 years old.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{壮健|そうけん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ご{多幸|たこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I wish everyone good health and happiness.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {壮健|そうけん}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧.

FORMAL USAGE: {壮健|そうけん} is often used in formal contexts, especially in greetings (ご{壮健|そうけん}で), letters, and formal speeches. It's particularly appropriate when inquiring about or commenting on the health of elderly or respected persons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{壮健|そうけん}で (I hope you're well - greeting)
- {壮健|そうけん}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (healthy body)
- ご{壮健|そうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to wish someone good health)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧ (healthy - more common)
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧ (healthy, energetic - casual)
- ⟦{頑健|がんけん}→頑健：09197_ganken⟧ (sturdy, robust)
- ⟦{矍鑠|かくしゃく}→矍鑠：09902_kakushaku⟧ (hale and hearty - for elderly)
